title: Example Public Participation and Deliberation Plan

schedule.urgent_exception: Written urgency reasons; immediate post-action consultation and review

participation.anti_retaliation: Confidential route and independent retaliation complaint

integrity.lobbying_disclosure: Publish material meetings, funding, and conflicts
integrity.anti_capture: Transparent moderation, duplicate detection, and representative outreach

deliberation.method: Public hearing and representative citizen panel where high impact

remedies.reconsultation_trigger: Material accessibility, manipulation, or evidence failure
